resources.string: Browse local files now. Cloud storage is not connected.

Cloud transfers are unavailable. The legacy Telegram storage architecture requires applicable permission under the Bot Developer Terms (5.2e–f). No approved cloud provider is connected. Local files and existing records remain available.
Upload a file to start building your library. Cloud uploads need an approved connection; you can add local files now.
No matching files. Try another search or filter.
Cloud transfers are disabled until a supported provider is approved. Adding a local file does not upload it or create a completed transfer.

Add local file opens the Android document picker. Files stay at their original location. Import an existing BlueDrive index from Documents/BlueDrive/bluedrive_files.txt to recover records without all-files access. Unavailable remote records can be inspected but cannot be downloaded in this build.

No BlueDrive account, advertising or analytics. Local metadata is stored on this device. Selected documents remain with their original provider. Sharing explicitly grants the chosen app access to the file. Legacy connection credentials are encrypted with Android Keystore where migration succeeds. No remote storage requests are made by this build.

BlueDrive
by DYPOL LABS

A native, account-free file library. Statistics describe only files indexed by this app, not remote capacity.

Choose bluedrive_files.txt in Documents/BlueDrive. The original stays unchanged; a recoverable copy is kept privately. Valid six- and eight-field records are merged by ID. Malformed or ambiguous lines are skipped.
No valid index records found. The original file was not changed.
The operation could not be completed. Your original files have not been removed.
Legacy cloud record. Remote availability has not been verified.
Remove only saved connection credentials? Indexed records and downloaded files will not be deleted.
Existing downloads in Documents/BlueDrive/Download remain unchanged. Remote downloads are disabled in this build. Use the system file manager to browse or manage those files.
Hide this record from BlueDrive? This does not delete the original file or any remote object. Restore hidden records in Settings.
